methodology: Real PlanStore fixtures (mkdtemp) and real reply builders; real MCP server over stdio; real HTTP server on a dynamic port. Nothing measures a database or SQL primitive: every number below is produced by a product scenario. Model tokens are not observable at these layers and stay null.

coreMeasurements.finding: The recommendation REPLY is size-bounded and independent of plan scale (1560 bytes at 27 and at 632 entities, claim list capped at 8); the full recommendation OBJECT grows with plan size (4566 -> 10341 bytes). The reported diagnostic cost lives in what adapters emit around the bounded core, not in the bounded core itself.

mcpScenario.finding: A start attempted after task/phase/feature reads still fails with REQUIREMENTS_READ_REQUIRED (the linked-requirements read was not part of the scripted reads) — the start gate costs one extra tool call per task, a concrete repeated-read contributor. Text-to-structured duplication is roughly 4x (6699 structured bytes vs 1723 text bytes for the same six calls).
